audience: freelancers and agencies that bill clients by time and project in NeetoInvoice

useCases.title: Find unbilled time for a project
useCases.text: List projects to find a project id. Then list the unbilled time entries of that project. Billed entries are left out.

useCases.title: Review clients and invoices
useCases.text: List the clients with their status and currency. List the invoices, newest issue date first.

useCases.title: Review missing timesheet days
useCases.text: List the weekdays with nothing logged for one user or the whole team, in a date range.

useCases.title: Log hours on a project task
useCases.text: Log hours on a project task for a team member on one date. The email of the acting team member is required.

useCases.title: Generate an invoice for a client
useCases.text: Generate an invoice from unbilled time and fixed-price projects. It runs in the background and returns the status generating first.

useCases.title: Record a payment or email an invoice
useCases.text: Record a payment received outside NeetoInvoice. Or send a generated invoice, which emails the client's recipients.
